t: Tojiro DP Chef Knife Review
s: November 29, 2025 - Tojiro is not a really well known brand, but it is well respected by professional chefs and serious home cooks. The DP 808 chef knife is probably the most popular knife Tojiro makes. While it is not the best chef knife Tojiro sells, it offers the most bang for the buck of any of their chef knives especially considering it is usually only around $100.

t: r/TrueChefKnives on Reddit: Starting a new job, are Tojiro Classic knives a good entry point?
Tojiro Knife Set Review: Sharp, Affordable, Extremely Well-Made | Bon Appétit
s: August 27, 2024 - Tojiro’s DP line is actually a combination of two types of steel: a higher-carbon VG-10 core sandwiched between two layers of stainless steel cladding. This sandwiching, which is actually an ancient sword making technique called san mai, yields a razor-sharp blade edge while also making the blade corrosion-resistant and easy to maintain. But because VG-10 isn’t a proprietary alloy (it’s available to most any knife maker who wants to buy it), Tojiro’s knives are generally cheaper than other legacy brands.

s: November 24, 2017 - The Takamura is a real laser, a lasers laser if you will and the Tojiro is a thin workhorse that hopes to grow up to be a laser. Having said that, the Tojiro DP line is a great line. With a wink and a nod from Mark we are all pretty sure the Yahiko VG-10 is just rebranded Tojiro DP with a lower price. t: Recommendation? - Anyone with experience with Tojiro knives? | BladeForums.com
s: September 18, 2020 - Each one has been hand reground to a full convex zero edge shape on wet & dry SiC paper using WD40 as a lubricant, currently with edge angles ~22.5 degrees inclusive (to have some reserve) Subsequent hand resharpening & thinning happens simultaneously (which saves time), and the knives cut significantly better than the stock versions. (So much so that some Chefs had me give their own much more expensive knives the same treatment) Imo both Tojiro (with their patented Decarburation Protection heat treatment) and Sakai Takayuki have the best "cooked" VG10 steel that i've found so far.
